## Summary

- what changed
- why it changed

## Approval

- [ ] docs-only change
- [ ] DeepSeek approval received for non-doc changes

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run check:deps`
- [ ] `npm run audit:ci`
- [ ] `npm run quality:test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] runtime or UI path checked manually

## Commit And Governance

- [ ] commit title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] hooks installed locally (`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`)

## Risk

- rollback impact
- external API impact
- new env vars or secrets
